div.div: Reading path ① The 28 V bus enters input conditioning. ② The conditioned bus feeds the pre-regulator. ③ The pre-regulator output feeds the four rail regulators. ④ Each rail reports power-good to the sequencer through its window monitor and current limit. ⑤ Current sense closes the peak-current-mode inner loop. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
